facts.text: The image is a multi-panel character reference sheet in portrait orientation, combining one large cinematic hero image with smaller turnaround and detail panels.
The top panel shows an adult standing upright on a rain-slick rooftop or industrial catwalk, with metal railings, falling rain, and blurred city lights behind.
The character has short dark hair with shaved sides and a small topknot, a visible scar through an eyebrow on the viewer's left in the FACE close-up, and a neutral expression.
The character wears a black high-collared tactical jacket with strap and buckle details over a dark shirt, black cargo trousers, and black lace-up combat boots.
A middle row shows three full-body views labeled FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, and BACK against a dark neutral backdrop.
A bottom row contains four close-up detail panels labeled FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.
The lighting is low-key and high-contrast, with cool blue-gray tones in the hero shot, warm amber background lights, and darker neutral studio lighting in the reference panels.
